title: Pure Bujin
summary: Bujin cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Bujin is a LIGHT Level 4 deck: Beast-Warrior Bujins on the field, and Bujingi Beasts and Winged Beasts that protect them from the hand or GY. The 2021 cards lead. Bujin Mahitotsu summons itself by sending a Bujin card from the hand, then trades a Bujin in the hand for one in the GY, or banishes one to mill another. Bujin Torifune tributes itself for two Bujins of different Types from the Deck. Bujincandescence shields your Beast-Warrior Bujins from the opponent's effects outside the Battle Phase and negates a card. Bujin Yamato searches every End Phase. Bujingi Turtle negates a targeting effect, Bujingi Quilin destroys a card, and Bujingi Crane doubles a Bujin's ATK in battle. Bujintei Susanowo searches or mills a Bujin each turn.
